protocol.phase_order: For trial r, H>P when (seed+r) is odd, P>H otherwise. Even6 repeats balance both positions and within-trial precedence. Identical seeded schedule for every filter.
protocol.raw_Page: Retain both scheduling slots, each using the public raw-byte API. Only the H slot is ranked. P summary fields are NaN and its JSON trial entries are null. The discarded P slot remains an equivalent warmup/query workload, not an extra ranked sample.
protocol.calibration_deduplication: API rows with the same bitmap/hash geometry share calibration_identity. Their identical seed samples must never be pooled as independent evidence.
protocol.timing_scope: Same noinline batch kernel in prehashed and common-hash modes; this is separate from compiler-visible single-key tracks. Explicit filter backing and temporary heap scratch are reported; allocator internals and RSS are not charged. One complete validated construction precedes query repetitions; no construction cost is ranked.
